method.ready_gpu: Process memory after load and warmup, with no audio requests; includes weights, engine cache and runtime, not request peak or checkpoint size.
method.weights: Serving checkpoint in the measured snapshot, excluding tokenizer, config, dictionary and CMVN.
method.venv: Logical per-environment size; shared hardlinks are counted repeatedly and cannot be summed as physical image size.
method.placement: One complete real recording per scenario, two requests per layout; warm cache effects cannot be separated from placement. Not an exhaustive minimum-GPU search.
method.raw_measurements: Recorded outside the repository; these aggregates are historical, not a current benchmark.

narration.decision: Keep four-GPU layout; first request was essentially unchanged.

conversation_tracks.decision: Distribute fusion models; quality metrics unchanged.

conversation.decision: Separate Pyannote, VibeVoice and review load; text metrics close.

meeting.decision: Separate VibeVoice from speaker/review load; speaker quality varied, performance benefit only.
